narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#4164

## Locked design

https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4164 is the bound contract (successor lean 5573709507). This child implements decisions 1-4 and the preserved-scope acceptance only. Do not add ROADMAP freshness to merge, check, lifecycle, or swarm paths. Closed unmerged [#4196](https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/4196) is the anti-pattern.

## What to build

Lock current ROADMAP policy with tests so a later worker cannot put `roadmap:check` on the merge lane or regenerate ROADMAP from `scope:complete` / `swarm:finalize-cohort`. `task roadmap:check` stays the explicit stale-output diagnostic. Manual `task roadmap:render` stays filesystem-based. The artifact-only lifecycle allowlist stays exactly `{xbrief/completed/**, CHANGELOG.md}`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `task roadmap:check` still fails a stale fixture and passes after render. Manual render and fixture-level renderer/drift tests keep their semantics.
- [ ] `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES`, `CONSUMER_CHECK_GATES`, Taskfile `check:framework-source`, Taskfile `check:consumer`, and the always-running TypeScript freshness lane omit `roadmap:check`.
- [ ] Lifecycle transitions and `swarm:finalize-cohort` do not write or require ROADMAP.
- [ ] Artifact-only allowlist remains exactly `{xbrief/completed/**, CHANGELOG.md}`. Two independent completion branches can land without editing ROADMAP.
- [ ] All new tests pass.
- [ ] `task check` passes.

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

## File scope (advisory)

- `packages/core/src/check/gate-lists.ts`
- `Taskfile.yml`
- `tasks/roadmap.yml`
- `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts`
- `.github/scripts/artifact-only-lifecycle.mjs`
- colocated tests for the above; do not open a ROADMAP write path in swarm or scope complete

Open critique of #4316 Wave 1 (policy lock; child of bound #4164). Tree `068831ea6b68afde722b2bfc2899f6ab87f880db`. Input ceiling comment 5714680103. Body SHA-256 `9cf00fcdc9932fad3d802a5e64f0d5b78f648619097817a52ffd0b2ef0bf3a52` (1830 bytes) matches the Stop 1 write-back.

No `blocks-the-design` finding. The child is bindable as a test-lock of current policy if acceptance names the four seams closed unmerged PR 4196 actually used, not only the Taskfile/TS gate-list omit.

Re-verified at the pinned SHA: `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES` / `CONSUMER_CHECK_GATES` omit `roadmap:check`; Taskfile `check:framework-source` lists `docs:rule-map:check` and `docs:capability-map:check` and does not list `roadmap:check`; `check:consumer` omits it; `tasks/roadmap.yml` has `render` and `check` only (no `sync-if-stale`); `packages/core/src/scope/transition.ts` has no ROADMAP write; `refreshRoadmapNative` on the release pipeline is the automatic producer; leftover-land prose in `lifecycle-write.ts` is already "completed/cancelled xBRIEFs + optional CHANGELOG".

### sharpens-framing — GitHub merge protection is the TypeScript suite, not `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES`

Evidence: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at this SHA records that live branch protection requires only the TypeScript aggregator; Go and merge-gate skip on `{xbrief/completed/**, CHANGELOG.md}`. `ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts` locks "TypeScript aggregator stays ungated by the artifact-only predicate". PR 4196's GitHub-effective pin was not only adding `roadmap:check` to `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES`; it also added `roadmapRenderMain(["--project-root", REPO_ROOT, "--check"])` inside the always-running vitest suite (`packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.test.ts` on that PR). Fixture-level `checkDrift` tests in `roadmap-render.test.ts` at this SHA do not touch the live repo. Child AC 2 says the TypeScript freshness lane must "omit `roadmap:check`". Parent #4164 preserved-scope says "the always-running TypeScript lane has no live-checkout ROADMAP freshness assertion." Those are not the same sentence. `ts:check-lane` is vitest; omitting the Taskfile name is vacuous.

Failure mode: a later worker leaves gate lists untouched, adds a live-repo `--check` (or `checkDrift` against checkout `ROADMAP.md`) in the required TypeScript job, and leftover-complete fails unless ROADMAP is regenerated. That recouples the shared snapshot to GitHub merge protection without putting `roadmap:check` on `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES`. Merge-gate is not the required check, so a gate-list-only lock does not police the lane that actually blocks merge.

Disposition: the child can bind after AC 2 is restated to the parent sentence (no live-checkout ROADMAP freshness assertion in the always-running TypeScript suite), with a test that would fail the 4196 live-repo `--check` pin. Do not treat "omit `roadmap:check`" as that lock.

### sharpens-framing — lock the producer files and a named `ROADMAP.md` false-case; "do not open a write path" is not a test

Evidence: PR 4196's producer half is `syncRoadmapAfterCompletedSetChange` from `runTransition("complete")` / restamp, plus `tasks/roadmap.yml` `sync-if-stale`, plus widening `.github/scripts/artifact-only-lifecycle.mjs` so leftover land can carry `ROADMAP.md`. Child file_scope (advisory) lists gate-lists, Taskfile, `tasks/roadmap.yml`, `ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts`, and the allowlist script, then says "do not open a ROADMAP write path in swarm or scope complete". `swarm:finalize-cohort` goes through `runTransition`; a later worker can also write ROADMAP after that loop in `finalize-cohort.ts`. Current `ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts` title is "allowlist is exactly CHANGELOG.md and xbrief/completed/**" but the body never calls `artifactOnly(["ROADMAP.md"])`. Adding `ROADMAP.md` to `isAllowlistedLifecyclePath` therefore leaves that test green. 4196 rewrote the test to `expect(artifactOnly(["ROADMAP.md"])).toBe(true)`. `LEFTOVER_LAND_PR_REMEDIATION` already excludes ROADMAP.

Failure mode: an implementer following file_scope adds `not.toContain("roadmap:check")` and leaves `transition.ts` / `finalize-cohort.ts` / `roadmap-render.ts` untested. A later worker repeats 4196's producer (complete-time render, `sync-if-stale`, allowlist widen). Wave 2's committed-input validator never sees that path: untrusted lifecycle files render into tracked `ROADMAP.md` at complete time, and two completion branches fight over one shared file. The existing "exactly" allowlist test does not fail the widen.

Disposition: bind only with named lock surfaces on `packages/core/src/scope/transition.ts`, `packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts` / `complete-cohort.ts`, and `packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts` (no `sync-if-stale`; complete/finalize do not write or require ROADMAP). AC 4 must require `artifactOnly(["ROADMAP.md"]) === false` and two-file leftover shape plus `ROADMAP.md` is false, not only the set in prose. Invert 4196's transition and renderer producer tests; do not rely on an implementer prohibition.

### sharpens-framing — worker-facing envelopes still command the shared write

Evidence: `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` at this SHA still has `- [ ] ROADMAP.md — updated if this closes a tracked issue (or N/A)`. That is the prompt that sends a later worker into 4196-class work (render on complete, then wire a gate when CI complains). `content/skills/deft-directive-refinement/SKILL.md` still requires `task roadmap:render` after triage batches; that is authoring, not merge-lane, and is outside decisions 1-4. The template checkbox is on every issue-closing PR, including leftover-complete.

Failure mode: tests stay green while the envelope still tells workers to edit the shared artifact. The next worker "fixes" red CI by weakening the new tests in the same PR (the 4196 move), because the prompt still asks for the write.

Disposition: the child can bind after the template checkbox is retired or rewritten so issue-closing / leftover-land PRs do not ask for a ROADMAP edit. Keep refinement-batch render out of this child's product change; do not treat the template as out of envelope just because file_scope omitted it.

### footnote — "two independent completion branches" is implied

AC 4's two-branch checkbox is the shared-state property of the producer lock above. A `runTransition("complete")` fixture that does not create or modify `ROADMAP.md` is enough. Do not add a multi-worktree git e2e as the lock.

### Existing mechanisms (inventory; do not add a new gate)

Use the omit pattern already in `packages/core/src/check/gate-lists.test.ts` (`verify:completed-tracked`, `verify:docs-impact`) and the Taskfile deps string-search used for `docs:rule-map:check` / `docs:capability-map:check`. Use `taskfile_check_lane.test.ts` for `check:framework-source` / `check:consumer` composition. Use `ci_lifecycle_lane.test.ts` plus `isAllowlistedLifecyclePath` for the allowlist. Keep fixture-level `roadmap-render.test.ts` semantics for AC 1 (`checkDrift` stale-fail / post-render pass; filesystem `render`). Keep `refreshRoadmapNative` as the sole automatic producer (decision 5 lives on Waves 2-3; Wave 1 must not grow a second one). Invert PR 4196; do not invent `verify:roadmap-policy`.

### Injection / swarm lens

This child changes merge authority (artifact-only skip of merge-gate), untrusted lifecycle inputs (xBRIEFs as render source), and shared artifact state (`ROADMAP.md`). Concurrent `scope:complete` / `swarm:finalize-cohort` writers on one tracked snapshot are a merge-conflict swarm failure. If Wave 1 leaves a complete-time write, Wave 2 provenance is bypassed: untrusted names and bytes reach the snapshot before release validation. The required GitHub check is TypeScript, so a live-checkout freshness assertion is an authority change even when Taskfile `check` is untouched. The PR template is an envelope that instructs that write. Deterministic control is the inverted 4196 tests, not reviewer attention.

### Road not taken

A new `verify:roadmap-not-on-merge-lane` Taskfile gate was the rejected extra mechanism. The anti-pattern already wrote the positive tests on the existing files; the lock is those tests with the opposite expect. Steelman of "gate-list omit is enough": local `task check` / merge-gate is the chokepoint in `gate-lists.ts` comments, and 4196 presented local attach as the aggregator. What flips that: this repo's required GitHub check is the TypeScript aggregator, 4196 also landed the live-repo `--check` pin and the complete-time producer, and the current allowlist test does not fail if `ROADMAP.md` is added. Those three facts hold at the pinned SHA.
